'''Jasis Temm''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who once owned and operated the company [[Hadlress Defense Systems, Limited]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hadlress]]. The company was sold for 4.6 billion [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Temm served as a mechanical [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] and security consultant for [[Prefect/Legends|Prefect]] [[Ilanda]] and pursued [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|hunting]] as a career.<ref name="BM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Temm was referred to as "Jasis Temmit" in the entry for "Hadlress Defense Systems, Limited" in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.
